review.note: Release 0.10.0 reuses the human review of official release notes and registry metadata performed on 2026-10-26 at approximately 10:59 UTC for these exact versions: hatchling 1.32.4, distlib 0.4.4, packaging 26.3, build 1.6.1, mypy 2.4.0, pytest 9.1.1, pytest-xdist 3.8.0, ruff 0.17.2, markdownlint-cli2 0.24.0. The source dependency manifest and requires-python >=3.14 are unchanged. That historical research found all stable latest versions within the existing lower-bound-only requirements; no stable latest was outside the bounds. This release generator independently queries current PyPI/npm metadata. Generated versions, Python eligibility and bounds results must still match the reviewed set before release approval; any drift is retained for additional human review and blocks the release handoff. Non-yanked artifact Requires-Python metadata admitted Python 3.14 in the reviewed snapshot; distlib omits Requires-Python but declares Python 3.14, while pytest-xdist lacks an explicit 3.14 classifier. Metadata eligibility is not native-platform or runtime-test evidence. hatchling: Version 1.32.4 restores the build-hook generic interface and corrects whitespace around version metadata. The 1.32.0 metadata default is 2.5. No new build hook or dependency-bound change is proposed. Official notes: https://hatch.pypa.io/dev/history/hatchling/. distlib: Version 0.4.4 corrects launcher errors and Python executable detection, and strengthens archive containment using data_filter. The 0.4.5 heading is explicitly unreleased. Native Windows launcher validation remains separate. Official notes: https://distlib.readthedocs.io/en/latest/overview.html#change-log-for-distlib. packaging: Version 26.3 adds VersionRange, supports metadata 2.6, fixes requirement/marker normalization and exceptions, and requires Python >=3.9. Existing PEP 440/508 parser use does not identify a required bound change. Official notes: https://packaging.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html. build: Version 1.6.1 fixes a Windows symlink-probe regression. Version 1.6.0 removes BuildBackendException.exc_info, adds CLI build/report features and deprecates project_wheel_metadata. Existing release workflow uses the build CLI; no dependency upgrade is requested. Official notes: https://build.pypa.io/en/stable/changelog.html. mypy: Version 2.4.0 enables the native parser, supports Python 3.15, ignores legacy for/with variable type comments, and drops accelerated macOS x86_64 wheels. CPython 3.14 macOS arm64 wheels are present. Existing strict checks remain the required compatibility evidence; none ran in this research. Official notes: https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/changelog.html. pytest: Version 9.1.1 fixes RaisesGroup diagnostics, indirect fixture parametrization, parametrization typing and initial conftest discovery. Existing source-authoritative pytest entry remains required; no gate/test outcome is inferred from these notes. Official notes: https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/changelog.html. pytest-xdist: Version 3.8.0 adds loadscope reordering controls. Requires-Python >=3.9 admits 3.14 but metadata does not explicitly classify Python 3.14. Actual local-worker source/ownership validation remains separate; this task does not alter worker policy. Official notes: https://pytest-xdist.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html. ruff: Version 0.17.2 fixes starred type-variable syntax handling and false positives, and marks comment-deleting fixes unsafe. Existing py314 formatter/lint settings should remain unchanged; this research did not rerun the fast gate. Official notes: https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.17.2. markdownlint-cli2: Version 0.24.0 updates dependencies including markdownlint. Fresh npm metadata requires Node >=22. This is compatible with the established Node 24 toolchain; no Node or package installation occurred here. Official notes: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/v0.24.0/CHANGELOG.md. The user approved the 0.10.0 breaking terminal-publication contract: all candidate, coverage, ancestor-unwind, owned-cleanup, deadline and pending-signal checks precede the final atomic canonical receipt rename; a successful terminal commit is not rolled back merely because its syscall returns after the deadline or a later interruption occurs. Post-commit invocation failure still blocks that merge. This batch also contains complete-round finding collection, Git metadata path/JSON serialization fixes, outer I/O failure handling and verified source-entry documentation/callers. No dependency or bound change is required by the reviewed dependency evidence. The unchanged local Markdown tool is 0.23.3 under Node 24; reviewing latest 0.24.0 does not assert it was installed or tested. The true non-UTF8 filename Linux end-to-end cases have not run: macOS rejects those filenames with EILSEQ, while direct serialization/reader/verify regressions are separately recorded; no Linux coverage is inferred from the audit. No fast/full/formal result is inferred from metadata research.
